notes.title: System Purge: Hollow Point - Next Fest 2024
notes.content:
System Purge: Hollow Point will be showcasing a new demo during Next Fest Oct 14th - Oct 21st.

Next Fest Demo includes:
[list]
[*]New Area - Replicant Labs
[*]New Obstacles
[*]New Cutscene
[/list]Your feedback makes the game better. Please feel free to add your comments to the ongoing feedback thread here. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2009160/discussions/0/4526764654812239295/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2009160/discussions/0/4526764654812239295/[/url]

We hope you enjoy the demo and please consider wishlisting. - we appreciate your support!

notes.title: New Demo Area - Replicant Labs
notes.content:
The System Purge: Hollow Point Demo has been updated. We are getting closer to launch and this might be the last major update to the demo! Release date coming soon.

Update includes:
[list]
[*]New Area - Replicant Labs
[*]New Obstacles
[*]New Cutscene
[*]Quality of life improvements based on community feedback
[/list]
Your feedback makes the game better. Please feel free to add your comments to the ongoing feedback thread here. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2009160/discussions/0/4526764654812239295/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2009160/discussions/0/4526764654812239295/[/url]

We hope you enjoy the demo, and please consider wishlisting. - we appreciate your support!

notes.title: System Purge: Hollow Point Demo Update
notes.content:
System Purge: Hollow Point demo has been updated with a few quality of life improvements. Some of these changes are due to feedback from the community. Thank you for your support!

- updated obstacles
- lighting changes
- pulsar wave frequency reduced
